text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Summer Training Camp with Biwa 
Hayahide had begun. And then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if on cue, Winning Ticket and Narita 
Taishin also showed up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each of them burns with ambition for the 
Kikuka Sho. A summer of rivals pushing 
each other to greater heights has arrived!
